title: thymus glabrescens subsp. degenianus
intro: Thymus glabrescens subsp. degenianus, commonly known as Degen's thyme, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and has been used to aid in digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and support immune function. The health benefits of Degen's thyme include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Degen's thyme include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
